title: Sony BRAVIA TL2 (device OD0M_EA_T32, built by TPV, MediaTek, ~1.7 GB RAM), Europe
header:
Sony BRAVIA TL2 (device OD0M_EA_T32, built by TPV, MediaTek, ~1.7 GB RAM), Europe
Android TV 11 (API 30), build RTM2.210929.098
Fingerprint: Sony/BRAVIA_TL2/OD0M_EA_T32:11/RTM2.210929.098/1594

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-tl2/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-tl2/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (classic Android TV, not Google TV); pass it to
restore.sh as above. Only it and Android's fallback claim HOME, so there is no
setupwraith-style trap when it is disabled.
Live TV app:    com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter

Not the usual Sony platform: this set is built by TPV (TP Vision) and carries the same
org.droidtv* / com.tpv_soem.* layer as examples/philips-50pus8517, plus com.mediatek.wwtv.*.
None of the Sony lists apply (no com.sony.dtv.*, Samba TV or Qterics packages). Read that
Philips list's quirks before disabling anything org.droidtv: none of them is disabled here.
Keep: org.droidtv*, com.tpv_soem.*, com.mediatek.* (tuner, HDMI, inputs), katniss + tts
(Assistant/voice), mediashell (Chromecast), tv.remote.service (phone remote) and anything
update-related.
org.droidtv.eum (e-manual) was only hidden from the launcher grid, never disabled; on the
Philips firmware disabling it breaks the sources drawer. For launcher/, a config.xml with
hidden_apps = com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, com.android.tv.settings, org.droidtv.eum keeps
Live TV in the Inputs menu and Settings in the top bar.
Already disabled on this set before the list was applied, so not listed (restore.sh leaves
them off): de.swr.avp.ard.tv (ARD), com.zdf.android.mediathek (ZDF), com.google.android.videos.

ADB: USB debugging alone opens port 5555; the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt appears on first
connect. The TV's screencap prints log lines before the PNG; strip everything before the PNG
header if a pulled screenshot will not open.
Applied 2026-10-19 in two batches with a screenshot, a Live TV check and a Chromecast check
after each, then reboot-checked: everything stayed disabled, Home, Inputs, Live TV, Cast and
voice fine. Not lived with for days yet.
